blocks.heading: Get Involved!

blocks.imageAlt: SAC members together at a campus holiday event

SAC flyer reading 'Less Stress, More Fun'. The Student Activities Council brings fun to NJIT through major events, volunteering, and social media and event coordinator committees. General meetings Wednesdays at 2:30, Campus Center 476.

items.title: The Social Media Committee
items.subtitle: 12:30pm on Wednesdays
items.body: Collaborate with the team to plan and create marketing materials that promote our organization's events and initiatives.

items.title: The Event Coordinator Committee
items.subtitle: 3:30pm on Wednesday
items.body: Collaborate with the team to brainstorm event concepts, design layouts for the Highlander Hub, and develop the strategic plans that bring our organization's initiatives to life.
